name: cm3-profitability
description: Per-product CM3 contribution-margin report from a Google Ads 'Shopping products' CSV (optionally enriched with a Shopify 'Gross profit by product' CSV). Outputs a detailed Clickt-branded multi-tab .xlsx, a 7-slide executive .pptx, and an Obsidian-ready .md. Segments products into CM3 bands and rolls up by campaign, category (L1-L5), product type (L1-L5), and vendor. Requires openpyxl and python-pptx.

interface.shortDescription: Measure product-level contribution margin from ad data.
interface.longDescription: Calculate per-product CM3 from Google Ads and optional Shopify exports, segment products into profitability bands, and roll results up by campaign, category, product type, and vendor.
defaultPrompt: Build a CM3 profitability report from this export.
Segment these products into CM3 performance bands.
Compare product profitability by campaign and vendor.
